book.name: Matayu
book.title: Vaaru poia to Yesu Krisi tau Matayu iboode Matyu—Matthew

content: Sadan itoov Yesu
Murei ra, Maaron Avuvu ipaburigin Yesu gha ila ivot nugh ŋginaaŋa. Leso Ŋeer Saghati itoova.
Yesu ilepleep ta sewe, ve iŋgun tauu pa ghaniiŋ aniiŋ le irau mboŋ tamoot ru. Saawe tana, i ighan aniiŋ eta mako, le pitoola kat.
Ra Ŋeer To Watiiŋ ivot tooni, ve isaav pani ighe: “Laak, isaav ighe yo Maaron Naatu, na usaav pa maet tane, ve tivot timin lem aniiŋ.”
Eemon Yesu iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Maaron aliiŋa tau tiboode na isaav tauvene:

content.text: ‘Aniiŋ mon irau igham tamtamon tileep poi ne mako.
Saveeŋ isov tau ivot ila Maaron aavo, tauta igham zi tileep poia.’”

content: Ra Ŋeer Saghati ighamu gha tila pa nugh patabuyaaŋ Yerusalem, ve tizala tiyooz ila Rumei Tiina paavo tau igheen saaŋa kat.
Ve isaav pani ighe: “Isaav ighe onoon yo Maaron Naatu, na uleep ta sene, ve uyatov ghom uzila. Pa Maaron aliiŋa tau tiboode na isaav ighe:

content.text: ‘I pale imbaaŋ aŋela tooni to tiŋgin ghom.
Yes pale tikis ghom, ve tipalot ghom.

content: Yesu iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Eemon Maaron aliiŋa ziiri ite tau tiboode na isaav tauvene:

Tauvene Ŋeer Saghati igham Yesu muul, ve tizala loloz tiina ee tau daaba izala kat, ve itotoi nugh naol isov tau kinik to taan tiŋgin zi, tomania gabua toozi popoia ve tintiina tau tipakur zi pani na, ve isaav pani ighe:
“Laak, isaav ighe yo uput aghem payau ve upakur ghau, yau aat napuliir gabua tawe tisov timin lem.”
Eemon Yesu iziire ighe: “Sadan, yo ughau ula! Pa Maaron aliiŋa tau tiboode na isaav tauvene:

content.text: ‘Uput aghem pa Tiina tsio Maaron mon,

content: Tauvene Ŋeer Saghati ipuli, ve aŋela siriv tilam ve tiuule.
Yesu ipaburigin uraat tooni izi Galilaia
Yesu ilooŋ Yoan vaaru tighe Erod ighuru iloŋ ila ruum to yavyavuuŋ, tauvene imuul ila pa taan sirivu to Galilaia.

Eemon ila ileep izi nugh puughu tooni Nasaret muul mako. Ipuli, ve ila ileep izi nugh Kapernaum tau igheen igharau nari to yaa naliu Galilaia. Nugh tawe igheen ila taan sirivu to yes Zebuluna ve yes Naptalia.
Tauvene Maaron aliiŋa tau muuŋ propet Isaia ivotia na, anooŋa ivot. Saveeŋ tauvene:

content.text: Yam tamtamon tau aleep izi taan to yes Zebuluna ve Naptalia igharau eez tiina tau izila pa te na,
tomania yam tamtamon tau aleep yaa Yordan paaŋa tau igheen ila pa aaz puughu na, alooŋ saveeŋ tane.
Yam Galilaia tau aleep tomania nugh nugh tau Yuda mako na, saveeŋ tane ilat payam.
Tamtamon tau tilepleep ila ndoroom loolo na, tighita ghazooŋa tiina.
Ve yes tau ndoroom to mateegh ikau zi na,

content: Saawe tana, Yesu ipaburigin uraat tooni to votiaaŋ vaaru poia. I isavsaav pa tamtamon ighe: “Apul ŋgar tsiam sasaghati ileple, ve atoor ŋgar tsiam imuul ila pa Maaron! Pa saawe to pooz to nugh sambam ivot ighazooŋ, ene ilam igharau wa!”
Yesu ipoi tamtamon paaŋ timin mbiwa tooni
Saawe ee, Yesu ilaghlaagh taghon nari to yaa naliu Galilaia, ve ighita zeran ru to ghamuuŋ iigh tiwaswaas. Ee, eeza Simon (tau eeza ite Petrus). Ve ite eeza Andreas. I Simon taazi.
Yesu isaav ila pazi ighe: “Ai, yamru alam ataghon ghau. Leso natotoi eez to ghamuuŋ tamtamon payam.”
Rekia mon yesuru tipul puugh toozi izi ileple, ve titaghon Yesu gha yesŋa tila.
Tilaagh tila rig, ve Yesu ighita Zebedi natŋa ru, Yakobus gha Yoan, yesŋa tamazi tilepleep izala waaŋ, ve tiyaim puugh toozi. Yesu isaav ila pazi ighe tilam titaghoni.
Tauvene yesuru paam, rekia mon tipul tamazi ileep tomania waaŋ toozi, ve tila titaghon Yesu gha yesŋa tila.
Yesu igham uraat izi Galilaia ve eval tiina titaghoni
Yesu ilaagh irau nugh nugh to Galilaia, ve ipaghazoŋai zi pa Maaron aliiŋa iloŋ ila rumei toozi. I ivovotia vaaru poia pa pooz to nugh sambam, ve ighagharaat zi pa moroghooŋ maata maata.

Yesu vaaru ilaan ila irau taan sirivu to Siria paam. Tauvene tamtamon tiyauyau moroghooŋa toozi tisov tila tooni. Yes tau moroghooŋ maata maata tomania yavyavuuŋ tiina igham zi, yes tau avuvu sasaghati tizeev zi, yes tau borau izazaa pazi gha titaptap tizizi, ve yes narapeŋa paam. Yesu igharaat zi tisov tinizi poia.

Tauvene eval tiina to Galilaia, ve eval tiina to taan sirivu to Dekapolis, tomania yes Yerusalema, ve yes to Yudea, ve nugh siriv tau tigheen tigharau yaa Yordan ziige ila pa aaz puughu na paam, timeke tila tooni, ve titaghoni gha yesŋa tilaghlaagh.
